answer: One concrete mechanism: pay rewards over a slow vesting curve tied to continued correct work, because gale only stays cheap while a farm must fund and babysit every clone for weeks before cashing anything out. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Nothing here needs to be perfect; it only has to make clones cost more than they return. Any juniper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
